A series of sessions on deep learning for non-technical audiences, building intuition without equations.

## Sessions

### [Session 1: Neural Networks](session-01-neural-networks.html)

The core concepts behind deep learning: neurons, weights, layers, activation functions, the forward pass, loss functions, and how gradient descent trains a network.

### [Session 2: CNNs & Transfer Learning](session-02-cnns-and-transfer-learning.html)

How convolutional networks process images, the feature hierarchies they learn, and how pre-trained ImageNet weights can be adapted to new tasks with limited data.
